common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Reasoning Stops Being Legible
common.line: The frontier models no longer allow intermediate reasoning a human can read, because the representations that work best are not words and never were.

common.title: Recursive Self-Improvement Begins
common.line: Frontier AI training can now be done basically without human intervention, and the pace stops being bottlenecked by human researchers.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Strait insurance freeze
notable.line: Strait inspection regime collapses into a full commercial insurance boycott, stranding the pencilled Japanese and Korean lots offshore and forcing EuroHPC rationing to hospitals only.
